raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

NVFP4 columnwise RHT on SM120/SM121 fails with `Assertion failed: rht_matrix != nullptr. Columnwise RHT requires an RHT matrix.` The scale-type dispatch wrapper introduced in #3325 accepts `rht_matrix` but passes `nullptr` to `quantize_transpose_impl`, discarding the valid matrix
provided by the SM120/SM121 path added in #3300.

Forward `rht_matrix` through the wrapper so columnwise RHT receives the supplied matrix. Calls that omit the optional argument continue to pass `nullptr`.

Related: #3062. This fixes the dropped-argument regression in #3325; the original shared-memory issue described in #3062 has a different cause.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Forward the caller's RHT matrix to `quantize_transpose_impl` for both NVFP4 scale types.

# Checklist

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete

- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

detail.title: [Common] Forward the RHT matrix in NVFP4 quantize dispatch

files.patch:
@@ -2062,7 +2062,7 @@ void quantize_transpose(const Tensor &input, const Tensor *noop, Tensor *output,
   TRANSFORMER_ENGINE_NVFP4_SCALE_TYPE_SWITCH(
       scale_dtype, ScaleType,
       quantize_transpose_impl<ScaleType, use_2d_quantization, apply_columnwise_rht>(
-          input, noop, output, quant_config, stream, nullptr);)
+          input, noop, output, quant_config, stream, rht_matrix);)
 #else
   NVTE_ERROR("FP4 support requires CUDA 12.8+, but compile-time CUDA version is ", CUDA_VERSION);
 #endif  // FP4_TYPE_SUPPORTED
